description: The Institute of Chartered Accountants of Sri Lanka - Amendment to LKAS 19 - Plan Amendment, Curtailment or Settlement - 01.01.2019
reasoning: This gazette content publishes amendments to the Sri Lanka Accounting Standard (LKAS 19) under the Sri Lanka Accounting and Auditing Standards Act, No. 15 of 1995. It contains detailed regulatory changes to accounting standards, which falls under the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) for regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements. The content does not involve government structure/personnel, land matters, commercial registrations, elections, public service, judicial matters, or other specialized categories that would take precedence.
